report:
Spec source review: CHANGES REQUESTED; two P2 source/documentation findings. Fixed base ecfd4b4d6ec54db30453f4b5112989e9fdbd0782, target7931b163f983a8b362374163b7949d31e68bbec4.

(a)/(c) P2 — ai/anthropic_minimax_payload.go:103–146. R20:252 requires “统一校验最终 stream、模型、消息、函数工具”. The Messages post-hook guard accepts a scalar messages value and tools:[{}]: the content walker treats noncontainers as valid and required function fields are not checked. Authorization does not supply those checks, and anthropic.go:134 sends the exact malformed bytes. Add failure-first public Client rejection cases and structural checks, preserving business JSON. This is a static source defect, distinct from vendor failures; no test was executed.

(c) P2 — docs/barness-ai/contract.md:359. R28:306 requires documenting “真实支持状态”. It claims BuiltinCatalog has no MiniMax formal model, although the activated data/catalog code includes all three M3 entries. Correct that configuration statement while retaining the distinction between M3 own formal evidence, M3.1 candidates and the incomplete whole release.

(b) No unasked scope creep confirmed. The protocol adapters retain existing Client/lifecycle boundaries; six model identities, exact reasoning/default/capability guards, cache/usage/price semantics, native history, isolation/resources, finite live provenance, frozen differential and rollback seams are implemented. All28 R,20 A and80 US identifiers have nonempty finite trace mappings (128 contract rows,1,304 unique required cases).

Mandatory acceptance remains incomplete independently of these source findings. R27:300 says “文本、工具往返、思考开启与合法续接、隔离、终态和资源约束均为必交”, and R27:302 requires “完整当前报告、目录/价格快照与门禁通过”. Current GLM Messages cancel is an actual FAIL; its120001ms detail cannot produce the required support report, strict publication and four-row import remain refused, and the original matrix remains unchanged. The first current full gate requires a separate completed-results addendum; this static review asserts no PASS/certificate. Original545/545 and new102/102 remain immutable, total647/647. No edits, tests, Keys, network or paid calls by the reviewer.
